description: Threadseer turns the event data already in Power BI into an interactive view of how work actually moves through a process. See where work waits, where cases repeat or loop, which paths deviate from the expected flow, and which factors are associated with those patterns. Designed for Power BI analysts, process improvement teams, and operations teams, Threadseer brings self-service process mining into the reporting environment they already use. Start with just three fields: Case ID, Activity, and Timestamp. Threadseer builds an interactive process workspace without requiring a separate process-mining platform, Threadseer account, Python runtime, or preprocessing application. Explore your process from multiple perspectives: Process Map & Variants — visualize activities, transitions and routes, with elapsed transition time, frequency or percentage of cases on connections. Optional Hierarchical Map — add your business hierarchy fields to view stages or departments, then expand a group to see its subprocess while keeping the surrounding process visible. Compare & Conformance — compare observed paths and measure exact-route conformance against accepted variants. Drivers, Bottlenecks & Rework — locate delays, repeated steps, return loops, processing-time patterns, and queue waits. Improve — explore handoffs, resources, regularity, and potential shortcuts. Cases — trace analysis…
keywords: Threadseer Process Mining for Power BI
